name: floating-reviews
title: Floating Reviews
prompt: Animate a lavender phone with a lifting review card, smiling emoji that blink, flipping star badges, and a separate user icon against a pastel sky.

name: community-team
title: Community Team
prompt: Sculpt a clay-style team portrait with four fully modeled characters, soft clothing contours, a five-fingered wave, reacting teammates, and floating icons that travel on separate paths. Keep a steady front view while the team waves, folds her arms, stands with hands on hips, and adjusts her glasses.

name: desktop-robot
title: Desktop Robot
prompt: Build a mint-green desktop robot that walks to a control console, taps its controls to light the display, then walks back and waves.

name: bethlehem-face-refinement
title: The Star Over Bethlehem
prompt: Tell the Nativity in six animated scenes. Follow the star from Bethlehem to the stable, where Mary, Joseph, and the shepherds gather around Jesus.

name: running-dog
title: Running Dalmatian
prompt: Loop a spotted Dalmatian galloping in profile, with long legs, floppy ears, and a tapered tail.

name: forest-lantern
title: Lantern in the Ghost Forest
prompt: Animate a girl glancing around a luminous forest as three smiling ghosts float, leaves sway, and fireflies drift around her flickering lantern.

name: copper-signal-meter
title: Copper signal meter
prompt: Animate a copper analog meter whose needle sweeps, overshoots, and settles as the indicator lights up.

name: coffee-pack-turntable
title: Coffee packaging turntable
prompt: Show the front label and back panel of a coffee package on a full-turn product display.

name: folded-flight
title: Folded flight
prompt: Send a paper airplane around a looping flight path with soft banking and a fading white trail.

name: late-night-record
title: Late-night record
prompt: Spin a vinyl record on a warm wooden deck with a gently moving tonearm and a glowing power light.

name: headland-beacon
title: Headland beacon
prompt: Sweep a lighthouse beam over a coastal headland and gently move the tide beneath a warm moon.

name: carry-on-fit
title: Will it fit?
prompt: Lower a carry-on into an open luggage sizer so the clearance is visible through the frame.

name: filter-cartridge-swap
title: Twist, lift, replace
prompt: Unlock and lift out a warm-colored filter cartridge, then seat a new mint cartridge in the same housing.

name: desk-lamp-exploded-view
title: See what’s inside
prompt: Show a desk lamp separating into its shade, bulb, support, and cable, then reassemble it.

name: local-file-journey
title: Where does my file go?
prompt: Move a file from a browser window through a local processor and into an export folder.

name: shipper-to-display
title: One box, three uses
prompt: Open a shipping carton, reveal the products, and fold its panels into a countertop display.

name: sofa-door-clearance
title: Before you move it
prompt: Rotate a sofa end-first, guide it through a narrow doorway, then turn it back in the next room.

name: showcase-market-baker
title: The last loaf
prompt: An apron-wearing baker scores a loaf at a street stall, leans in, then lifts the warm bread as steam curls up.

name: showcase-moon-rover
title: Moon rover
prompt: Loop a tiny lunar rover rolling across pink regolith with turning wheels and blinking antenna.

name: showcase-folded-bloom
title: Folded bloom
prompt: Open a folded paper flower petal by petal and gather it back into a bud.

name: rolling-die
title: Spinning die
prompt: Spin a white die in place, with rounded corners, black pips, and a soft shadow.

name: showcase-tiny-mail
title: Tiny mailroom
prompt: Animate a lavender envelope that opens, lifts a heart letter, and seals itself again.

name: showcase-tide-light
title: Tide light
prompt: Make a bioluminescent jellyfish pulse while four ribbon tentacles drift beneath it.

name: bento-m-rig-wave
title: Lighthouse keeper
prompt: A lighthouse keeper in a yellow raincoat blinks, waves, and settles back into their stance.

name: spacewalk-astronaut
title: Spacewalk
prompt: Animate a floating astronaut waving in zero gravity, with a ringed planet and a softly glowing suit light.

name: delivery-scooter
title: Scooter delivery
prompt: Animate a delivery courier riding a mint scooter through a passing neighborhood, with turning wheels and a gentle suspension bounce.

name: bento-m-showreel
title: Lotus pond
prompt: A koi circles a lotus at dusk. Let the tail steer the swim while rings ripple outward.

name: basketball-ink
title: Jump shot
prompt: A line-drawn basketball player dribbles twice and sinks a jump shot. The ball bounces back across the court, and the player scoops it up to start the loop again.

name: showcase-tape-deck
title: Tape deck
prompt: Animate a retro peach cassette with turning reels, an equalizer and a blinking play light.

name: showcase-peach-tea
title: Peach tea bounce
prompt: Animate a sleepy peach boba tea that bobs, blinks and wiggles its straw on a lavender stage.

name: showcase-blue-dive
title: The blue dive
prompt: A humpback swims through a kelp forest, banks and sweeps its tail while a school of fish parts around it.

name: bento-m-twinkle
title: Mountain night
prompt: Stars twinkle above a moonlit mountain range.

name: bento-m-jiggle
title: Surprise gift
prompt: Animate a wrapped gift box that wiggles before opening and sending up confetti.

name: showcase-evening-ride
title: Evening ride
prompt: A cyclist pedals along a riverside promenade as lamp posts slide past and their scarf trails in the evening breeze.

name: mixed-breed-dog
title: Running tan dog
prompt: Loop a tan mixed-breed dog galloping in profile, with floppy ears and cream paws.

name: mobile-onboarding-walkthrough
title: Mobile onboarding walkthrough
prompt: Present an onboarding screen on a 3D phone, with two callout cards that lift away from the screen.

name: showcase-aurora-prism
title: Aurora prism
prompt: Float an asymmetric icy prism above a luminous pedestal and sweep colour across its facets.

name: showcase-postcard
title: Rain or shine
prompt: Loop a weather card where a sun peeks over drifting clouds and raindrops dissolve.

name: showcase-orbital-mint
title: Orbital mint
prompt: Loop a midnight orbit of shiny enamel tokens, narrowing their faces as they turn.

name: bento-m-sway
title: Window garden
prompt: A potted plant sways gently in the late-afternoon light.

name: dashboard-highlight
title: Dashboard highlight
prompt: Present five performance bars on a 3D dashboard and float a tooltip over the strongest result.

name: flying-swallow
title: Flying swallow
prompt: Loop a blue barn swallow in flight, with a deep downstroke, folded recovery, and a gently bobbing body.

name: scene-rocket
title: Rocket launch
prompt: Make a rocket lifting off with flame, smoke puffs and twinkling stars in the background.
